ops.en: THE FIFTH SUMMONS. BO el-paro VE-DIBARTA elav — 'COME to Pharaoh and SPEAK to him': the errand-formula again (the fifth sounding of the send-formula behind it — 5:1, 7:16, 7:26, 8:16, here); ko amar YHWH elohe ha-IVRIM — the Hebrews'-God credential (3:18's coinage, standing); SHALACH et-AMI ve-yaavduni — the standing demand re- pressed: the machine pushes the errand-card knowing its class (the unn…

THE CONDITION. ki im-MAEN ata le-shaleach — 'if you REFUSE to send' (7:14's refuse-verb, the third conditional built on it); ve-ODKHA MACHAZIQ bam — 'and STILL HOLD THEM FAST': the grip-participle (the strengthen-root chazaq — the same root the hardening-ledger conjugates: the hand that grips the people and the heart that grips itself share one verb-family, the machine files the pun of the ledger)…

THE HAND. hine yad-YHWH HOYA be-miqnekha — 'the HAND of the LORD IS upon your cattle' (the being-word hoya — the Name's own verb in a rare feminine participle, the readings' present-tense hand, named- only); the FIVE species enumerated (horses, donkeys, camels, herds, flocks — the readings note the horses first: the sea's chariots already grazing here, named-only); DEVER KAVED MEOD — 'a very HEAVY…

THE APPOINTMENT. va-yasem YHWH MOED — 'and the LORD set an APPOINTED TIME': the calendar-word (the moed that will name the festivals — the readings, named-only) spent on a plague's schedule; MACHAR — 'TOMORROW': the machine files the pre-announced clock (8:6's king chose tomorrow; now Heaven sets it unasked): the plague that can be dated cannot be called weather — the argument-by-scheduling the ha…

THE AUDIT. va-YISHLACH paro — 'and Pharaoh SENT': the send-verb the whole book demands of him — spent on an AUDIT (asserted: the one dispatch the king makes is inspectors to Goshen; the machine files the irony in the ledger's own verb); ve-hine lo-met... ad-ECHAD — the distinction CONFIRMED by the throne's own commission ('not even ONE'); va-YIKHBAD lev paro — and the heart grows heavy on the evid…

THE SIXTH COMMAND. QECHU lakhem melo chafnekhem PIACH KIVSHAN — 'TAKE handfuls of SOOT OF THE FURNACE' (the furnace-word: the readings hear the bricks' kilns — the oppression's own ash thrown back at heaven, named-only); u-ZERAQO moshe ha-SHAMAYMA — 'and let MOSES THROW it HEAVENWARD': the throw-verb (the blood-rite's future verb, unhunted) aimed UP for the first time; le-ene faro — the publicity-…

PLAGUE SIX. va-yiqchu... va-yaamdu lifne faro — they took and STOOD (the stand-verb whose lean file this chapter carries [EX09-05] — the brothers stand where the magicians are about to fall); va-yizroq oto moshe ha-shamayma — the throw performed; va-yehi SHCHIN AVABUOT poreach — the boils BLOOM (the bloom-verb: the readings' dark flowering, named-only): the machine pops the card in its own next ve…

THE TURN. va-yechazeq YHWH et-lev paro — 'and THE LORD STRENGTHENED the heart of Pharaoh': the FIRST DIVINE HARDENING (asserted — the machine's ledger turns its page: through five plagues the heart strengthened itself or the king made it heavy; at the sixth, 7:3's declared policy ACTIVATES: va-ani aqshe — 'and I will harden' — begins to perform; the readings' five-and-five doors — he closed the fi…

THE THIRD MORNING-STATION. HASHKEM ba-boqer ve-HITYATZEV lifne faro — the early-rising formula's second sounding (8:16's card-class: the errand whose delivery goes unnarrated); shalach et-ami ve-yaavduni — the send-formula's SIXTH sounding: the machine pushes the seventh plague's errand and notes the liturgy's escalation — what follows (9:14-19) is the longest warning-speech in the cycle: the plag…

THE INDICTMENT [EX09-13]. ODKHA MISTOLEL be-ami — 'you STILL EXALT YOURSELF over My people' (the self-exalting participle, Torah- unique, unhunted — the highway-word's root: the king paves himself over the people); le-vilti SHALCHAM — 'not to send them': the send- refusal restated as the exaltation's content; and the Kitzur reads the COUNSELOR'S NAME riding the clause's letters (Balaam — 'for thre…

THE STRETCH-COMMAND. NETE et-yadkha AL-HA-SHAMAYIM — 'STRETCH OUT your hand TOWARD HEAVEN': the stretch-formula's third plague (blood 7:19, frogs 8:1 — Aaron's arm; now MOSES' own hand, and not over waters but toward the SKY: the machine files the escalation of both agent and axis); vi-yhi VARAD... al-ha-adam ve-al-ha-behema ve-al kol-esev ha-sade — the target-list read out (man, beast, every herb…

THE CENSUS. va-YAKH ha-barad — 'and the hail STRUCK': the strike- verb (2:11's file, the plague-cycle's own meter) with its census read out — all in the field, man to beast, every herb, every tree SHATTERED (shiber — the break-verb's debut on timber): the machine files the ledger against 9:19-21's columns: what the fearer housed lives, what the heedless left is itemized here — the branching verse-…

THE EXEMPTION. RAQ be-eretz GOSHEN... lo haya barad — 'ONLY in Goshen there was NO hail': the distinction-file's third station (the swarms 8:18, the cattle 9:4, now the sky itself sorting by border — the machine notes the escalation: the exemption now governs WEATHER); asher-sham bene yisrael — the residence-clause: the file is armed forward (10:23's light in the dwellings, 11:7's silent dogs): th…

THE CONFESSION. CHATATI ha-paam — 'I HAVE SINNED this time': the throne's first confession (the sin-word enters the king's mouth — the machine opens the confession-ledger knowing its half-life: 9:34's sinned-AGAIN is seven verses away); YHWH HA-TZADIQ va-ani ve- ami HA-RESHAIM — 'the LORD is THE RIGHTEOUS ONE, and I and my people THE WICKED': the court-vocabulary complete (the readings on the defi…

THE THIRD ENTREAT [EX09-05]. HATIRU el-YHWH — the entreat-demand's third issue (8:4, 8:24, here — the throne's one reliable prayer: make it stop); ve-RAV mi-heyot QOLOT elohim u-varad — 'ENOUGH of there being VOICES OF GOD and hail' (the king's own theology surfacing in the panic: qolot ELOHIM — he names the thunder's Owner; the lean thunder-word again [EX09-01]); va-ashalcha etkhem — the send-pro…
